limitations: Baseline means original pre-expansion source 1ee6 measured again in batch C. The original before-edit capture and earlier series remain separate; no attempts are pooled.

Batch D and batch C share recorded tools, lock, route and settings but differ in capture time and light background activity. Baseline and basement predecessor comparisons across batches are observational.

Actual camera position/focus/cutaway IDs were not captured. The API existed from basement onward; the old helper incorrectly called it unavailable. Those raw records remain unchanged. Do not infer identical camera state from equal zoom/player pose.

Three-floor scene populations differ intentionally from baseline/foundation. Common routes do not visit the basement, career exhibits or exterior. The raw unavailableCheckpoints field is profile omission, not proof that basement was absent.

Rolling diagnostics hold at most 180 rendered-frame wall-clock intervals, omit intervals >=1000 ms and provide no reset/sample timestamps. Count 180 does not isolate the dwell. Phase diagnostics are retained privately, not CPU/GPU frame timing.
Every route observed one external requestAnimationFrame interval >=1000 ms. Whole-route stall probes remain separate from renderer diagnostics; event dispatch delay is not input-to-paint.
Geometry/texture counts are resource counts, not GPU bytes. Post-route residency is not the 125-geometry launch limit. These captures do not prove teardown disposal or full reclamation.
Hardware p95 <=80 ms, real phone evidence, full stage routes and owner walkthrough remain separate gates. No budget change or speedup/equivalence claim.
